title: Go 1.27 JSON v2 instrumentation prevents customer builds
claim: Under Go 1.27.0, encoding/json selects its jsonv2 implementation, whose Decoder has dec and opts fields and no decodeState methods. The unconditional advice still injects references to Decoder.r and Decoder.d, so Orchestrion-generated encoding/json code does not compile. This blocks instrumented customer builds.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/base-test-127 && GOTOOLCHAIN=local go tool orchestrion go test -shuffle=on -timeout 20m ./...

title: Go 1.25.9 is rejected by the declared minimum Go version
claim: The integration test application declares go 1.26.6, so GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.9 rejects the module before Orchestrion runs. There is no separate source-level toolchain guard; the module directive is the effective unsupported-toolchain guard.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/base-test-127/iast/integration/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.9 go tool orchestrion go build ./cmd/bootstrap
